note: Ps47 enthronement (corrected method; drop-off). Human IB=3: rinnah jubilant joy, yare reverent fear of God the King, zamar sing-praises (x5 emphatic = 1 char + couplings). God-acts (bachar chose, aheb loves Jacob) = qualifiers. Outward acclamation (rua/teruah shout, gaon pride-of-Jacob, holy throne, princes) = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: 'Clap your hands, all peoples! Shout to God with loud songs of JOY (rinnah)' — the exuberant jubilation of the nations before God the King; rinnah (recurs Ps30:5) the ringing joy expressed in clapping and shouting, worship at its most exultant

'For the LORD, the Most High, is to be FEARED (yare), a great king over all the earth' — the reverent awe owed the great King; yare here the fear due God's universal kingship, the awe that grounds the peoples' worship — joy and fear together
prompted by God's choosing and loving of his people (v4)

'SING praises (zamar) to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!' — the insistent fivefold call to praise the enthroned King; zamar (recurs widely) the praise commanded again and again, the worship due the God who chose and loves his people (v4 = the qualifier) and reigns over the nations
the choosing that prompts the people's praise (v4->v6)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'He CHOSE (bachar) our heritage for us' - God's electing is not a human IB char; the deed grounding the people's praise (279122). Qualifier.
God's love for Jacob, ground of praise (v4->v6)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's love): 'the pride of Jacob whom he LOVES (aheb)' - God's love for Jacob is not a human IB char; the divine affection grounding the people's praise (279122). Qualifier.
the shouting that expresses the joy (279094)
v1: 'SHOUT (rua) to God' - the jubilant cry that expresses the peoples' joy (279094); the vocal manner of the rejoicing. Qualifier.
emphatic repetition of the call to sing (279122)
v6: 'sing praises!' (zamar) - the emphatic repetition intensifying the call to praise (279122). Qualifier (emphasis).
emphatic repetition of the call to sing (279122)
v6: 'Sing praises to our King' (zamar) - the third of the fivefold repetition (279122). Qualifier (emphasis).
emphatic repetition of the call to sing (279122)
v6: 'sing praises!' (zamar) - the fourth of the fivefold repetition (279122). Qualifier (emphasis).
emphatic repetition of the call to sing (279122)
v7: 'sing praises with a psalm (maskil)!' (zamar) - the fifth call, urging skilful praise of the King of all the earth (279122). Qualifier (emphasis).
pride / excellency (gaon - the pride of Jacob)
v4: 'the PRIDE (gaon) of Jacob whom he loves' - gaon here the excellency/glory of Jacob's heritage (the chosen land), an outward attribute of the inheritance, not an inner operation. Standalone.
shout / acclamation (teruah - gone up with a shout)

v5: 'God has gone up with a SHOUT (teruah), the LORD with the sound of a trumpet' - the festal acclamation at God's enthronement-ascent; the outward shout of the ceremony, not an inner operation. Standalone.
v8: 'God sits on his HOLY (qodesh) throne' - the holiness of the throne; an attribute of God's throne/place, not an inner operation. Standalone.
princes / nobles (nadib - princes of the peoples)
v9: 'The PRINCES (nadib) of the peoples gather as the people of the God of Abraham' - the assembling nobles of the nations; persons gathering, not an inner operation. Standalone.
